mechanism: Detect short-term swings with a 3-bar rule (low[i]<low[i-1] and low[i]<low[i+1], mirrored for highs). Collect short-term pivot indices and promote a middle short-term high/low to intermediate only if it is strictly higher/lower than neighboring short-term pivots; apply the same builder again on intermediate pivots to obtain long-term swings. Nested layers give a hierarchical structure read of trend direction and major turns.
data_needed: OHLC bar series on the attached chart timeframe
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any symbol/TF; demos on XAUUSD H1; author suggests daily or H1 for enough bars
why_new_for_mis: MIS can treat the three swing layers as concurrent regime-structure sensors (micro/meso/macro pivots) rather than a single fractal pivot list, enabling nested regime labels and structure-break alerts when a higher-layer swing invalidates.
quote: Larry Williams divides swing points into three groups. These are short-term, intermediate-term, and long-term swings. Each group is built from the one below it, allowing us to see the structure forming layer by layer.

mechanism: Once per new bar on the chosen TF, measure yesterdayRange = high[1]-low[1]. Project buy/sell entry gates from today's open ± (range × buy/sell multipliers); place stops at entry ± (range × stop multiplier); take-profits from risk×reward. Enter only on decisive M1 close crossover/crossunder of those gates with a single open position.
data_needed: Prior completed bar high/low, current open/bid/ask, M1 closes for cross detection, account balance for risk sizing
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD Daily backtest Jan–Nov 2025; timeframe input PERIOD_CURRENT; M1 used for crossover confirmation
why_new_for_mis: Senses volatility expansion as a daily (or chosen-TF) event relative to the immediately prior bar range, producing adaptive breakout thresholds and volatility-scaled risk distances that MIS can stream as expansion-state features.
quote: when a market experiences an extensive range in a single day, it often signals the start of a new trend... When today’s price action surpasses a certain percentage of yesterday’s range, it suggests that the market is likely to continue moving in that direction.

mechanism: A smash bar must not be an outside bar; its close must break below (buy) or above (sell) the lows/highs of N lookback bars. Confirmation when the next bar closes back above the smash high (bullish) or below the smash low (bearish). Lookback inputs control strictness of the emotional extreme.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NASDAQ 100 (NAS100) H1 demo; PERIOD_CURRENT so any attached TF
why_new_for_mis: Formalizes failed-breakout / crowd-trap reversals as discrete change events with an explicit non-outside-bar filter and lookback depth—useful as a regime-change pulse distinct from ordinary swing pivots.
quote: A smash day reversal begins with a strong and emotional push in one direction that appears to confirm a breakout... Instead of following through, the market quickly fails and turns back the other way on the next session.

mechanism: Bullish hidden smash: close higher than prior close but close in the lower 25% of the bar's own range (optional close < open). Bearish: close lower than prior but in the upper 25% of range (optional close > open). Optional mode waits for next bar to close above smash high / below smash low before marking.
data_needed: OHLC; close-in-range fraction (25%); validation mode bar-only vs confirmed
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD Daily demo; logic applied to any timeframe's bar range
why_new_for_mis: Senses intra-bar exhaustion via close location within the bar range despite a directional close—a microstructure-of-the-bar change sensor that standard OHLC pivots miss.
quote: For a valid Hidden Smash Day Buy Bar, the close must be located in the lower portion of the bar’s range... although the session finished, buyers failed to hold most of the gains made earlier in the bar.

mechanism: Gap bar opens outside prior bar range by ≥ minimumGapSizePoints×_Point (down below prior low / up above prior high). Signal when gap bar or a later bar within maxGapValidityBars closes back through the prior extreme; only the first fill of each gap is accepted (no duplicate signals).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any chart symbol/TF; gap threshold in points so calibration is instrument-specific
why_new_for_mis: Treats opening gaps as time-bounded reversal setups with first-fill-only semantics—a clean gap-fill change event stream for MIS across sessions and instruments.
quote: A bullish gap bar opens below the previous bar’s low, while a bearish gap bar opens above the previous bar’s high. The distance... must be at least minimumGapSizePoints... Only the first qualifying fill is accepted.

mechanism: Build RBF kernel covariances K, K_s, K_ss on past vs next time indices of close-to-close changes; invert K (with noise + diagonal ridge); mean forecast mu_* = K_s·K^{-1}·y; predictive variance from diag(K_ss − K_s K^{-1} K_s^T); optional 95% bands via ±1.96√var. Normalize forecasts to [0,1] with <0.5 bearish / >0.5 bullish.
data_needed: Close price changes over m_past bars; hyperparameters variance σ_f² and length-scale m_next
why_new_for_mis: Provides a probabilistic sequence sensor that emits both directional mean forecasts and quantified uncertainty—usable as confidence-gated regime projection rather than a point signal alone.
quote: when predicting, they do more than provide a single value. Instead, they provide an uncertainty estimate that would include the desired value, as well as an upper bound and lower bound value.

mechanism: While Gator histograms show sleeping/red (no clear trend) then a lip color flip, require price break of recent highs/lows with AD at a local max/min over a short window—reading rising AD in a flat Gator range as latent accumulation (and falling AD as distribution) that foreshadows breakout direction.
data_needed: Bill Williams Gator oscillator colors/histograms; Accumulation/Distribution line; OHLC
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: GBPJPY M30 primary tests; H4 Gator referenced in multi-TF pattern 9
why_new_for_mis: Pairs a trend-sleep detector with a volume-flow bias to sense which way a quiet range is being accumulated—liquidity positioning as a pre-breakout regime feature.
quote: When the gator is flat with no trend, but AD is trending up on up, one should expect that the next significant move is likely to be a bullish breakout.

series_key: mql5 wizard techniques you should know
mechanism: When Gator shows mixed awakening colors (trap/head-fake context) and price closes beyond recent highs/lows, require AD also to print a local extreme in the breakout direction; absence of AD confirmation marks a volume-failed breakout that can reverse once price reclaims the zone with AD catching up.
data_needed: Gator UP/LO colors; AD series; recent High/Low
why_new_for_mis: Explicit false-breakout / trap sensor: price structure awakens without volume substance—useful as a change-quality filter that downgrades breakouts lacking liquidity confirmation.
quote: not every ‘awakening’ of the gator leads to a bullish trend - the case for head fakes... the AD would remain flat or even decline, bespeaking a lack of real accumulation.

mechanism: Require primary-TF Gator eating green (or mirrored bearish) while higher-TF (H4) Gator also shows green on at least one histogram, plus LTF price break and H4 close direction alignment (pattern 9). Uses HTF trend as regime filter for LTF volume/price entries.
data_needed: Gator on M30 and H4; AD on LTF; closes on both TFs
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: GBPJPY M30 execution with H4 Gator filter
why_new_for_mis: Multi-timeframe Gator alignment is a concrete regime gate: only admit lower-TF change events when higher-TF trend/volume context agrees.
quote: the higher timeframe gator acts as another trend filter by providing trend affirmation, with the lower timeframe AD providing a precise volume-confirmed entry.

mechanism: Compute basic bands at (high+low)/2 ± multiplier×ATR. Ratchet: while prior close respected the band, only tighten it (MathMax on support / MathMin on resistance); else reset to basic band. Binary trend flips when close crosses the opposite band; plot active band and optionally delayed flip arrows. Persist sUp/sDn/sTrend as INDICATOR_CALCULATIONS buffers so recursion does not wipe.
data_needed: High/low/close; ATR(period); multiplier; recursive prior-bar state
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD, EURUSD, USDJPY, GBPUSD mostly H1; EA backtests on those four
why_new_for_mis: Volatility-scaled ratchet stop that encodes a persistent binary up/down regime with clean flip events—suitable as a primary regime sensor and ATR-relative distance-to-band feature.
quote: while price stays above the upper band, the upper band is only allowed to rise, never fall back down. The moment price closes below it, the ratchet resets and a fresh band value is accepted.
